newsitem.title: USA: America West May load factor 68.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: America West May load factor 68.2 pct.

text.p: America West Airlines Monday reported May 1997 traffic at 1.4 billion revenue passenger miles (RPMs), up 5.7 percent over the same month last year.
Capacity increased 9.4 percent to a record 2.0 billion available seat miles (ASMs) resulting in a passenger load factor of 68.2 percent compared to 70.6 percent in May 1996.

America West also reported record year-to-date 1997 traffic at 6.7 billion RPMs, up 10.5 percent over the same period a year ago. Year-to-date ASMs increased 14.1 percent over 1996 to a record 9.7 billion, resulting in a year- to-date passenger load factor of 68.9 percent compared to 71.1 percent in 1996.
